fields.Name: Dynamics 365 Business Central
fields.Description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central API credentials using Azure Entra ID OAuth2. Holds the Azure app registration credentials (Client ID, Client Secret, Tenant ID), the Business Central Company GUID, and the environment name (Production, Sandbox, or custom). The connector exchanges Azure credentials for OAuth2 access tokens and uses them to access the Business Central REST API (v2.0 or v1.0).
